tool.name: BAM Readcount
tool.description: Generate metrics at single nucleotide positions
tool.command: ln -sf '${input_bam.metadata.bam_index}' input.bam.bai && ln -sf '$input_bam' input.bam && ln -sf '$reference_fasta' input.fa && bam-readcount -f input.fa #if $site_list: -l '$site_list' #end if -q '$advanced.min_mapping_quality' -b '$advanced.min_base_quality' -d '$advanced.max_count' #if $advanced.per_library: -p #end if #if $advanced.insertion_centric: -i #end if -w '$advanced.max_warnings' input.bam #if $region: '$region' #end if > '$output'

param.name: input_bam
param.label: BAM/CRAM file
param.help: Input alignment file. Must be coordinate-sorted and indexed.

param.name: site_list
param.label: Site list
param.help: Tab-separated file (no header) with one region per line: chromosome, 1-based start, 1-based end. Cannot be used together with a region string.

param.name: region
param.label: Region
param.help: Limit output to a single genomic region in samtools format: chr:start-end (1-based). Cannot be used together with a site list.

validator.message: Region must be in chr:start-end format

param.name: min_mapping_quality
param.label: Minimum mapping quality
param.help: Minimum mapping quality of reads used for counting.

param.name: min_base_quality
param.label: Minimum base quality
param.help: Minimum base quality at a position to use the read for counting.

param.name: max_count
param.label: Max depth
param.help: Maximum depth to avoid excessive memory usage.

param.name: per_library
param.label: Report per library
param.help: Report results separately for each read group library.

param.name: insertion_centric
param.label: Insertion centric
param.help: Generate insertion-centric readcounts. Reads containing insertions will not be included in per-base counts.

param.name: max_warnings
param.label: Max warnings
param.help: Maximum number of warnings of each type to emit. Use -1 for unlimited.

tool.help:
**BAM Readcount**
Generates low-level metrics at single nucleotide positions from a BAM or CRAM file. Outputs include observed bases, read counts, mapping and base qualities, strandedness, mismatch counts, and read position statistics.
Originally designed to help filter genomic mutation calls; the output is also useful as input for variant detection tools.
-----
**Inputs**
*BAM/CRAM file* Coordinate-sorted and indexed alignment file.
*Reference FASTA* Reference sequence. Required for CRAM files and to report the reference base at each position.
*Site list* (optional) Tab-separated file (no header) restricting output to specific positions::
chromosome<TAB>1-based-start<TAB>1-based-end
*Region* (optional) Restrict output to a single region using samtools format: ``chr:start-end`` (1-based).
-----
**Output**
Tab-separated, one line per position::
chr position ref_base depth base:count:avg_mapq:avg_baseq:avg_se_mapq:num_plus:num_minus:avg_pos_frac:avg_mismatches_frac:avg_mismatch_qual:num_q2_reads:avg_dist_q2:avg_clipped_len:avg_dist_3p ...
One set of colon-separated fields is reported for each possible base (=, A, C, G, T, N).
With **Report per library** enabled, each line additionally contains one ``library_name { ... }`` block per read-group library.
-----
**Advanced Options**
- *Minimum mapping quality*: exclude reads below this MAPQ (default: 0) - *Minimum base quality*: exclude bases below this BQ (default: 0) - *Max depth*: cap pileup depth to limit memory use (default: 10,000,000) - *Report per library*: break down counts by read-group library - *Insertion centric*: report insertion counts; reads with insertions are excluded from per-base counts - *Max warnings*: cap repeated warning messages per type (default: 0; use -1 for unlimited)
